turns.transcript: How do I try this demo?
turns.reply: Welcome to the Patchbay Voice demo. Type below, or hold the mic button and speak. To watch me read the project, try asking: What sections are in the readme? Then, to see me save a note for you, try: Write a note called ideas.md with three features the widget store could add. Tap the sessions button in the top left to switch to the second project or start a new one.
